title: Mitten Market Lost Ticket Binder Ring Story Connection Card

kidDirection: Writer: invent a mitten stall, a folded ticket, and a helper who connects one small detail to another made-up detail: ____________________.
firstDetailPrompt: first detail: write one pretend mitten stitch, ticket fold, or stall mark the helper notices first: ____________________.

quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the first detail and connects to blanks, then pause with the adult: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep this paper connection card and add one new mitten market detail later with an adult: ____________________.
